note: Recorded Security Chief turns for Meridian on Wilshire, matched by src/agents/chief/recorded.ts on the alarm transition. The first turn whose `when` matches answers; a transition with none gets the deterministic template (template.ts). Zone ids are the ones the Run screen sends for the F3 fixture floor: the cached manifest's zones and entries (data/levels/F3.night-desk.json; these replies are kept per building, so any mission on F3 reuses them), and the floor's other rooms by id. Written for the straight walk in: C1's analytics see the player in the north hall on turn 1, which goes straight to lockdown.

orders.rationale: C1's analytics flagged someone in the north hall: lockdown. G4, out of suite 2410, and G3, from the south hall, converge on it. G2 holds the prototype lab. G1 blocks the loading dock. Lock the lab.
